summary: All five repair targets are valid question-shape fixes: remove recommendation wording from pending questions and reframe q3 away from implementation details.

items.title: 1. q1 includes a recommendation
items.rationale: The pending question should contain only the question text. The recommendation phrase is not needed to preserve the user decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question starts with recommendation wording before asking about record-and-proceed as a non-pass outcome.

items.title: 2. q2 includes a recommendation
items.rationale: The pending question should ask about the user-visible display requirement without embedding the suggested answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question starts with recommendation wording before asking about status and final report display.

items.title: 3. q3 includes a recommendation and internal implementation detail
items.rationale: The user decision should be about visible classification naming, while internal artifact compatibility can be decided by project patterns during spec writing.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question asks whether to keep current internal failureKind values in existing artifacts.

items.title: 4. q4 includes a recommendation
items.rationale: The pending question should ask about recommendation ordering without leading with the preferred answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question starts with recommendation wording before asking about first and repeated failure behavior.

items.title: 5. q5 includes a recommendation
items.rationale: The pending question should ask about fail-closed boundaries without embedding the recommended answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[4].question starts with recommendation wording before asking about workflow integrity exclusions.
